jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager - EMEA & APAC
jobs.description:
ONWARDS TOGETHER!

Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters.

Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave™ for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running.


REMOTE IN EMEA/APJ



OUR TEAM'S VISION:

Our Marketing team illuminates and evolves the global brand, driving revenue and empowering future success for our Sales team. As a leader in Zero Trust Segmentation, we are dedicated to helping organizations prevent cyberattacks and mitigate the impact of ransomware.

Renowned for our innovative solutions and collaborative spirit, we foster an inclusive environment within Marketing and across the company. Join one of the industry's most creative and dynamic teams, where you'll discover opportunities to excel, be empowered to set ambitious goals and define your path to success!

We're hiring a Digital Marketing Manager to own paid digital performance across EMEA and APAC, running the channels that drive pipeline in these regions while making sure our campaigns actually land with local audiences, not just translated ones.

You'll report into our global campaigns team based in the U.S., acting as the regional expert who knows what works (and what doesn't) in these markets, while keeping campaigns aligned with global strategy and brand.



YOUR IMPACT:

 - Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns across Google, LinkedIn, programmatic, and Reddit for EMEA and APAC audiences

 - Manage regional budgets and pacing, and report on performance against pipeline and revenue targets

 - Serve as the point person for localization, briefing translators and agencies, reviewing localized landing pages and campaign assets for accuracy and cultural fit, and flagging where a literal translation won't land the way the message needs to

 - Integrate closely with field marketing leaders across EMEA and APAC, aligning digital campaigns with regional events, account-based programs, and pipeline priorities

 - Partner with regional sales teams to make sure campaigns reflect local buying behavior, competitive landscape, and compliance needs, such as GDPR in EMEA and data residency requirements across APAC markets

 - Ensure regional campaign and customer data is stored and processed in accordance with local data residency requirements, working with IT and legal as needed

 - Bring market intelligence back to the global team, including what's resonating regionally, where global assets need adaptation, and where regional nuance should shape global strategy

 - Test and iterate on channel mix, targeting, and creative by market rather than applying a one size fits all playbook


YOUR TOOLKIT:

 - 4+ years running paid digital campaigns (Google, LinkedIn, programmatic; Reddit experience a plus) in a B2B SaaS environment

 - Experience marketing across multiple EMEA and/or APAC markets, with a clear understanding that localization means more than translation

 - Track record of working closely with field marketing to align digital programs with regional events and campaigns

 - Familiarity with regional data privacy and residency requirements (GDPR and equivalents)

 - Comfortable working async with a team based in a different time zones, and a strong written communicator who can bring the U.S. team up to speed without a meeting for everything

 - Analytical enough to defend your budget allocation with data, not instinct

 - Based in EMEA or APAC, fully remote

#LI-OM1 #LI-REMOTE

Our Commitment



Illumio believes that an environment of unique backgrounds, experiences, viewpoints, and individual contributions creates a culture of belonging, drives our future, and makes us stronger together in support of our customers and their success.



All official job offers from our company are extended directly by our recruitment team and will be sent through an official E-Signature document for your review and signature. Please be aware that we do not ask for any personal information in the process of extending offers of employment, such as financial details or social security numbers. Upon acceptance of any offer, we will request such information as part of the onboarding process prior to or on your first day of employment, and only after completing a background check through an authorized third-party vendor. If you receive any communication asking for personal details outside of these processes, please contact us immediately to verify the authenticity of the request. Your security is important to us, and we are committed to a safe and transparent hiring experience.

For roles in San Francisco and Los Angeles: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Illumio will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Customer Success Advisor
jobs.description:
ONWARDS TOGETHER!

Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters.

Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave™ for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running.


LOCATION: TAIWAN (REMOTE)

OUR TEAM’S VISION:

Our Customer Experience organization exists to help every customer realize the full value of their investment in Illumio.

Our vision is simple: every customer reaches value quickly, sustains that value over time, and operates with confidence every day. Delivering on that vision requires more than exceptional technology. It takes a unified team of Customer Success Advisors, Technical Account Managers, Professional Services, Support, and Training & Enablement working together to help customers achieve successful outcomes throughout their journey - from implementation and adoption to optimization, expansion, and long-term operational success.

We partner with many of the world’s largest enterprises to solve complex security challenges, reduce cyber risk, and maximize the business value of their Zero Trust Segmentation investments. Whether we’re guiding a deployment, providing strategic advice, resolving a critical issue, enabling new capabilities, or improving the customer experience at scale, our purpose remains the same: helping customers achieve their objectives and become more secure and resilient.

Joining Customer Experience means becoming part of a collaborative organization united by a shared commitment to customer success. If you’re passionate about building trusted relationships, solving meaningful business and technical challenges, and making a measurable impact for customers around the world, you’ll find exceptional opportunities to grow your career while helping shape the future of cybersecurity.

 


YOUR IMPACT: 

As a Customer Success Advisor (CSA), you are a critical part of the Customer Success Organization reporting to the Director of Customer Success. Your role will be directly tied to value generation for our customers, by helping them develop the right strategy to onboard, adopt, and successfully utilize Illumio's products to achieve their desired outcomes. The results of your efforts should lead to healthy, adopted, referenceable customers that achieved value-based outcomes and are eager to expand their use of Illumio across their organization.

 - Develop cross-functional knowledge that spans IT Security, IT Operations, Infrastructure, and Application Portfolio Management practices. Your ability to partner with all teams within Illumio (like Sales, Professional Services, Support, Product Management, Engineering, Office of the CTO) to drive a strategic roadmap for your customers will be vital to your success. 

 - Customer Adoption - inspect customer adoption issues and run specific plans to increase adoption health where required to ensure that all customers are wildly successful with Illumio's platform.

 - Renewals - tie adoption health to renewal and ensure that value is being delivered. You will be expected to forecast your upcoming renewals whilst managing the process from start to finish.

 - Expansion - partner with Sales to identify expansion opportunities and ensure we realize the expansion sales potential within your portfolio.  Identify growth opportunities in your portfolio of accounts to improve NRR (Net Retention Rate) for the company.

 - Establish “trusted advisor” relationships with the executive stakeholders and technical teams on the customer side while working seamlessly with our account team to extend Illumio’s reputation and position as a vendor.

 - Establish, confirm, and document the “definition of success” with the customers executive sponsors through quarterly ‘Executive Business Reviews’.

 - Build a strategic roadmap for every customer that defines how they should consume and adopt Illumio’s products to meet their desired outcomes.

 - Monitor the Adoption Health across all accounts within your portfolio.

 - Marshall the support of our cross-functional organization to successfully onboard a customer quickly and with the highest quality possible.

 - Identify product or feature gaps, coordinate responses and timelines with the Illumio product team and successfully orchestrate their delivery.

 - Capture and document Customer Use Cases, value stories, and other useful information to help contribute to, and increase the depth of our Customer Success repository.


YOUR TOOLKIT:

 - 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, or related, customer-facing role

 - Ideally you will have worked within the Cyber Security or Enterprise SaaS space

 - Proven ability to build trust and communicate effectively with C-Suite, VP, and Director-level contacts, along with day-to-day users of the platform

 - Excellent communication skills verbal, written and presentation

 - Detail-oriented with the ability to set priorities and be flexible in an ever-changing environment

 - Bilingual proficiency in Mandarin Chinese and English, with the ability to support local customers and partners effectively
